nodes.name: Sources
nodes.notes: One item per source = one branch each. The source key must exist in Hyperfocus (Admin → Job sources). Add Greenhouse or Lever boards here.

nodes.name: Fetch pages
nodes.notes: Follows the 'next page' link (Arbeitnow); Greenhouse and Lever answer in one page. At most 10 pages a run.

nodes.name: Sign
nodes.notes: HMAC-SHA256 of '<timestamp>.<body>' with the same INGEST_SECRET as the Hyperfocus server.

nodes.name: Send to Hyperfocus
nodes.notes: 202 = queued. A replay of the same key is answered 202 again and changes nothing.
